data.name: Buzur
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ba-Zur', meaning 'to protect, to guard'. This name evokes a sense of security, strength and responsibility. In Islamic history, it is mentioned in the story of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and his servant, Al-Habib Al-Azdi, who was known as 'Abu Zar' or 'Buzur'. When Ibrahim (AS) was about to be thrown into the fire, Abu Zar remained steadfast in his faith and was eventually spared. Thus, the name 'Buzur' serves as a reminder of faith, perseverance, and unwavering loyalty.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes protection and guardianship, both in the physical and spiritual realm.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Buzur are creative, self-expressive and charismatic. They are also very compassionate and caring. They have a strong sense of responsibility and are often protective of those around them.

in_arabic.name: بوزُر
in_arabic.long_meaning: بوزر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه كبير أو عظيم، و هو مشتق من الجذر ب-وز-ر الذي يدل على الكبر و العظمة. ورد في بعض المراجع اللغوية العربية أن بوزر هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و الشرف.

in_urdu.name: بوزُر
in_urdu.meaning: بوزر کا مطلب ہے بڑا یا عظیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: بوزر ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بڑا یا عظیم۔ یہ جڑ ب-وز-ر سے ماخوذ ہے جو بڑائی اور عظمت کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ عربی لغت میں ذکر ہے کہ بوزر ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو رفعت اور شرف کے معنی رکھتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں، بوزر ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عظمت و شان کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बुज़ुर
in_hindi.meaning: बुज़ुर का अर्थ है बड़ा या महान
in_hindi.long_meaning: बुज़ुर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है बड़ा या महान। यह मूल ब-وز-ر से निकला है जो बड़े और महानता की ओर संकेत करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, बुज़ुर एक ऐसा नाम है जो महानता और प्रतिष्ठा को दर्शाता है। यह नाम पारंपरिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: بوزر
in_pashto.meaning: بوزر د لوی یا عظیم معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بوزر یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددی نوم مطلب دی لوی یا عظیم. دا د ب-وز-ر جذر څخه مشتق شوی دی چی د لوی او عظمت ښودلو لپاره کارول کیږي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، بوزر یو داسی نوم دی چی عظمت او شان څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Buzur
in_english.meaning: Buzur means great, large, or magnificent
in_english.long_meaning: Buzur is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the root b-w-z-r, which conveys the meanings of greatness, largeness, and magnificence. In Islamic tradition, the name Buzur signifies grandeur, nobility, and high esteem. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures to denote someone of great stature or prestige. The name is associated with positive attributes such as leadership, honor, and respect.

historical_references.reference: Buzur was the name of a Persian city, located in present-day Iran. It was a significant trade center during the Sassanid Empire (224-651 AD). The city was famed for its vibrant marketplace, which attracted merchants from various parts of the ancient world.
historical_references.context: Significant trade center with a vibrant marketplace

historical_references.reference: Buzur is also mentioned in historical records as the site of a major battle during the Islamic Conquest of Iran (642-651 AD). The Battle of Buzur took place between the invading Arab forces led by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas and the Sassanid forces under Yazdegerd III. It is said that Sa'd emerged victorious and captured the city, thereby expanding the territory under Islamic rule.
